facts.fact: The responsible department in Uttar Pradesh is the Department of Food and Civil Supplies, whose website is fcs.up.gov.in
facts.quote: Department of Food and Civil Supplies, Uttar Pradesh Government Email : up [dot] fncs [at] gmail [dot] com Phone Nos. : : 18001800150 Website : State Food Department Website https://fcs.up.gov.in/

facts.fact: Ration card / PDS complaints in UP go to the Grievance Redressal System at cms.up.gov.in
facts.quote: Grievance Redressal System for E2E PDS https://cms.up.gov.in/

summary: Confirmed on nfsa.gov.in State: Uttar Pradesh page: Department of Food and Civil Supplies (fcs.up.gov.in) and PDS grievance system cms.up.gov.in.
